history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-heal-curve2-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: after the curve study over starts 1-360 (runs 44131018812, 44131024789), the owner asked for reserve (0, 100, 200) x curve (50, 75) on the next bigger dataset. Reserve 100 and curve 75 are new arms, so this pilot comes first (RULES 16); the big tier follows once its gate passes, as the owner asked.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#192). Pilot (RULES 16) of six arms, four of them new
(reserve 100, curve 75); the big tier (classes-1800 starts 361-900) follows once this gate passes, on the
owner's standing request. Gate: no config_error; one binary; the three borg_param_town_heal_* lines with
the arm's values (reserve 0/100/200, curve 50/75, speed 66) in every borg.txt and in params-core.json of
the death replays; no plan loaded; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts
classified (purchase bursts are not stalls); death bundles reproduced. Consistency: r0-c50 and r200-c50 are
the curve pilot's arms of the same names (run 44125061301, same specimen and starts) and must replay its
key hashes. Report per arm: deaths, final level, deepest level, paired rescued and newly killed against
r0-c50. 18 starts per arm show direction only.
experiment.question: Below the shipped reserve and curve, which healing reserve (0, 100, 200) and curve scale (50, 75) should the town planner use at speed 66?
